story: Zoe and her sister Lucy go to the market to buy food. They see many people sell goods there. They want to save money, so they do not spend much.
title: At the Market
setting: A busy outdoor market with many food stalls.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: A young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt.

characters.name: Lucy
characters.look: A young girl with long brown hair and a blue dress.

sentences.en: Zoe and her sister go to the market.
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe with short black hair and Lucy with long brown hair walk into a busy outdoor market.

sentences.en: Many people sell food at the stalls.
sentences.zh: 许多人在摊位上卖食物。
sentences.scene_prompt: A man at a market stall is handing a bag of bread to a customer.

sentences.en: The expensive pizza costs many dollars.
sentences.zh: 昂贵的比萨饼要花很多美元。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe and Lucy look at a large, fancy pizza on a table.

sentences.en: This cheap food is very good.
sentences.zh: 这种便宜的食物非常好吃。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lucy smiles while looking at a small piece of bread.

sentences.en: Rich people spend a lot of money.
sentences.scene_prompt: A man in a fancy suit carries many shopping bags.

sentences.en: They go to the bank later today.
sentences.zh: 她们今天晚些时候要去银行。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe and Lucy walk toward a large building with columns.

sentences.en: One cent is a very small price.
sentences.zh: 一分钱是一个非常小的价格。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe looks at a single small coin in her hand.

sentences.en: Lucy has a question about the cost.
sentences.scene_prompt: Lucy points to a price tag on a box of fruit.
